_note: Same wire as `google/batch.getStatus` - Google returns the results inline on the batch resource itself, so reading status and reading results are one request. Kept as its own id because they are two OPERATIONS, and a future divergence should be a diff here rather than a surprise. Auth is the x-goog-api-key HEADER, never ?key= in the URL: a key in a query string is copied into every access log and telemetry span the request passes through.
